description: This is a PHP test class for the LDAPUserSyncAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for LDAP user synchronization API methods, setup hooks for LDAP configurations, and tests for getOne and create functions with data providers. It also includes unimplemented tests for CRUD operations.

classes.name: LDAPUserSyncAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing LDAP user synchronization API in OrangeHRM. It includes test methods for retrieving and creating LDAP sync entries, setup hooks for different LDAP configuration scenarios, and unimplemented placeholders for update, delete, and retrieval of all records.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single LDAP user sync record using data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for testGetOne method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests LDAP user sync creation API with data provider, including setup if LDAP server is configured.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test case data for testCreate method.

methods.name: syncPassPreHook
methods.description: Sets up LDAP sync status to simulate a successful sync.

methods.name: syncFailedPreHook
methods.description: Sets up LDAP sync status to simulate a failed sync.

methods.name: ldapConfigPreHook
methods.description: Configures LDAP settings with basic parameters and saves to database.

methods.name: ldapConfigSyncEnablePreHook
methods.description: Configures LDAP settings with synchronization enabled.

methods.name: ldapInvalidConfigPreHook
methods.description: Configures LDAP settings with an invalid user lookup setting for testing error conditions.
